desc: 半高领宽罗纹无帽卫衣，罗纹领口挺括，宽松廓形，秋冬换季印刷版式套图
leaf: 半高领宽罗纹无帽卫衣
name: 半高领宽罗纹无帽卫衣款

shots.intent: 用印刷版式爆框在搜索结果里第一眼抢点击，一秒给出换季上新主张
shots.textZone: 上部卡纸爆框内一行主张位「{selling_point_1}」，框外不给任何文字位

shots.intent: 把核心卖点压缩成一行主张加四个空徽章位，一屏读完不换脑
shots.textZone: 徽章带上方一行主张位「{selling_point_2}」，四个云朵徽章内部一律空置不填字

shots.intent: 给出坐下状态下的整体廓形与衣长，让买家把自己代入到穿着里
同机位双联对照交代宽松廓形与领口高度，消除版型与显臃肿疑虑
shots.textZone: 两栏正上方通栏一行主张位「{selling_point_3}」，栏内不留正文位

shots.intent: 细节索引墙逐格交代领口、肩缝、袖口与下摆，讲清怎么做成的
shots.textZone: 实心柠檬块内两行标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，其下各三行完全空置的正文横线位

shots.intent: 领口罗纹微距是最硬的质量证据，一眼看到织纹与挺度
参数页把所有数字交给运营填，用空白行与空刻度承接规格疑问
shots.textZone: 参数块上方一行标题位「{callout_3}」，四行参数值与三条刻度值全部留空不填

shots.intent: 尺码矩阵与洗护符号框把合身与护理风险挡在下单前，格位一律留白
shots.textZone: 矩阵上方一行表头位「{callout_4}」，五行五列表格单元与五个符号框内部全部空置不填数字

shots.intent: 收口屏用空按钮位承接点击，会员与促销信息一律不编造只留版式
shots.textZone: 右侧竖排空字规不填字，左下空按钮位上方一行行动文案位「{callout_5}」

style.backgroundSystem: three alternating printed plates only: full-bleed acid-lemon #F7D02C, ice-blue micro-dot field #C3E4F0 and card-stock cream #FBF6E9 held inside hard ink #1B1A1F hairline frames; the plate is always a flat printed plane, never a scenic, outdoor or in-store backdrop and never a gradient
style.direction: risograph print-shop menswear cover board commerce
style.iconSystem: letterless cloud-outlined badges and one blank jagged-edged burst tag in ink #1B1A1F hairline at a single stroke weight, plus blank tick scales with an empty sliding marker; no filled medallion, no 3D icon, no numbered capsule, no solid pictogram
style.lightingSystem: neutral print-shop light, firm key from the upper left around 5000K, one crisp flat same-direction ink shadow, a thin skimming fill only on macro frames, no softbox bloom, no warm cast, no rim light off the plate
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent risograph print-shop cover board system for a men's ribbed mock-neck pullover top across the entire image set; fixed palette of acid-lemon plate #F7D02C, ice-blue micro-dot field #C3E4F0, ink hairline #1B1A1F and card-stock cream #FBF6E9 plus one product-matched accent; neutral print-shop light with a firm key from the upper left around 5000K and one crisp flat same-direction ink shadow, no softbox bloom; one heavy geometric sans-serif for Chinese label slots, every readable line supplied later as a placeholder and all latin display rules kept letterless; hard-edged hairline photo frames, blank cloud-outlined badges, one blank jagged burst tag and blank tick scales as the only graphic parts; garment worn on an invisible ghost form or a generic figure cropped below the jaw, with stable garment scale and placement; no fifth hue, no gradient, no scenic backdrop, no mixed fonts, no blurred shadow, no readable face.
noDrift: no fifth hue beyond #F7D02C, #C3E4F0, #1B1A1F and #FBF6E9 plus one product-matched accent
no gradient, glow or blurred drop shadow under any frame
no scenic, outdoor or in-store backdrop, no clothing rail and no shelf
no serif, brush or hand-lettered headline and no mixed fonts
no readable model face and no identity-defining features
no QR code, membership tab, price tab or discount numerals
no invented fibre percentages, gram weights, size figures or care temperatures
style.presentationRules: the garment is shown on an invisible ghost form or a generic adult figure cropped below the jaw, at identical scale, identical key direction and identical shadow hardness on every screen; the rib collar stays the visual anchor and the plate layout never shifts between screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte card-stock cream #FBF6E9 board, printed acid-lemon #F7D02C plate and an ice-blue #C3E4F0 dot-matrix print sheet laid on one flat plane; no wood, no stone, no fabric tabletop, no floor perspective
style.typography: one heavy geometric sans-serif for Chinese label slots plus letterless vertical ink rules for the latin display line; every readable line arrives later as a placeholder and the display rules stay empty
